description: List the runs of one sweep, by the sweep's `id`: each run has an id, status, a summary (total, pending, running, passed, failed, error), the test run ids it started, when it started and finished, and whether it was started by hand or by a schedule. Use when: the user asks how a named sweep has been doing. For every sweep run in the workspace use listSweepRunsForWorkspace; for one run's per-persona results use getSweepRun. Read-only. Needs testing:read. Returns 404 if the sweep is not in your workspace.
name: listSweepRuns

items.description: One execution of a `TestSweep` — one TestRun per profile.

summary.description: Roll-up counters for a sweep run.

testRunIds.description: TestRun IDs created by this sweep (one per profile).

title: List Runs of a Sweep
